title: 49ers lose FB Kyle Juszczyk to knee injury, lead Broncos 17-14

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers lose FB Kyle Juszczyk to knee injury, lead Broncos 17-14
sources.description: The 49ers are trying to close out a win over the Broncos on Sunday afternoon and they won't have the help of fullback Kyle Juszczyk the rest of the way.
